name: year
description: Calendar year of the record date

name: month
description: Calendar month of the record date

name: record_date
description: Last day of the month the statement reports

name: fiscal_year
description: U.S. federal fiscal year of the record date, running October through September

name: src_line_nbr
description: Source line number within the MTS table, stable across releases for a given line
observations: Part of the natural key (record_date, src_line_nbr)

name: parent_id
description: Classification id of the parent row in the statement hierarchy, empty for top-level rows
observations: Pairs with classification_id to reconstruct the tree within a release

name: classification_id
description: Classification id of the row within a single release, not stable across releases
observations: Regenerated each release; use src_line_nbr as the stable key

name: classification_desc
description: Name of the receipt source, spending agency, budget function, or financing category the row reports

name: sequence_level_nbr
description: Depth of the row in the statement hierarchy, from 1 at the top to deeper components

name: current_month_gross_receipts
description: Total receipts of the U.S. government in the current month

name: current_month_gross_outlays
description: Total outlays of the U.S. government in the current month

name: current_month_deficit_or_surplus
description: Budget deficit (negative) or surplus (positive) in the current month
